item.title: Banks Wrap Up Loan Backing SoftBank’s $5.4 Billion Robotics Bet
item.description: A group of banks wrapped up a loan offering backing SoftBank Group Corp.’s $5.4 billion robotics bet after increasing the size of the US dollar tranche.

item.title: This ETF Tax Loophole Is All the Rage Among Rich Americans
item.description: A bespoke fund is becoming a must-have tool for wealthy investors looking to defer — and sometimes even avoid — capital gains tax.

item.title: Nintendo Scores Hit With Tomodachi Life as Gamers Seek Escape With Life Sims
item.description: Six years after Nintendo Co.’s Animal Crossing: New Horizons became a lockdown phenomenon, the company is scoring another major hit worldwide from gamers seeking an escape from rising anxiety and isolation.

item.title: Moody’s Lifts Argentina Debt Rating in Fresh Boost to Milei
item.description: Moody’s Ratings upgraded Argentina’s credit score, giving the nation its third sovereign upgrade in less than three months and further validating President Javier Milei’s economic overhaul plan.

item.title: Alaska Airlines Narrowly Beats Estimates as Fuel Costs Stay High
item.description: Alaska Air Group Inc. earnings outlook slightly beat analyst predictions as the airline grapples with rising fuel prices from the war in the Middle East.

item.title: Super Micro Jumps After Early Results Show Rising Backlog
item.description: Super Micro Computer Inc. shares rose about 15% in extended trading after the server maker issued preliminary results saying its backlog hit a record on new orders in the quarter of more than $60 billion.

item.title: Capital One Profit Beats Estimates as Loan-Loss Provisions Drop
item.description: Capital One Financial Corp., the biggest US credit-card lender, swung to a profit in the second quarter as it set aside less money to cover bad loans than Wall Street had anticipated.

item.title: Canadian Stocks Climb as Gold Surge Offsets Trump Tariff Threat
item.description: Canadian stocks climbed Tuesday despite US President Donald Trump threatening 50% tariffs on the country’s exports, thanks to surging gold prices and a rally in tech hardware stocks.

item.title: OpenAI Names BNY, Nubank CEOs to Board Ahead of IPO
item.description: OpenAI has appointed two financial services executives to its board of directors, drawing on their experience as the company moves toward a Wall Street debut.

item.title: OpenAI Says Its AI Used for ‘Unprecedented’ Hugging Face Breach
item.description: OpenAI said its artificial intelligence models were used to compromise the internal systems of startup Hugging Face Inc., offering an early glimpse of how AI systems could fuel new cybersecurity threats.

item.title: Robinhood Prediction Market Revenue to Top Crypto, Analysts Say
item.description: Trading platform Robinhood Markets Inc.’s revenue from prediction market is set to overshadow that from cryptocurrency trading, starting as soon as the second quarter, analysts at Bernstein and Piper Sandler said this week.

item.title: Subprime Auto Dealer Goes From Covid-Era Rockstar to Near Demise
item.description: America’s Car-Mart Inc. thrived during a ‘90s slump, the 2008 financial crisis and the upheaval of Covid-19 by doing one thing well: selling and financing older, high-mileage used cars for cash-strapped, deeply-subprime buyers.

item.title: Treasury Flags Concern Over ‘Potentially Abusive’ Tax Trades
item.description: The US Treasury Department has expressed concern over a number of high-profile tax strategies touted by Wall Street that it says may be “too good to be true.”

item.title: Iberdrola Agrees to Buy 80% Stake in Caruna for €2 Billion
item.description: Iberdrola SA agreed to buy an 80% stake in Finland’s main electricity distribution network Caruna Group for €2 billion ($2.3 billion).

item.title: Oaktree’s Poli Sees a $200 Billion ‘Distressed Moment’ Coming as Rates Stay High
item.description: Companies with $200 billion in debt face a reckoning as funding costs stay high and debt comes due over the next few years, according to distressed specialist Oaktree Capital Management.

item.title: Trump’s Latest Tariffs Cast Doubt on Canada Investment Revival
item.description: President Donald Trump’s latest trade threat against Canada carries a stark reminder for businesses weighing expansion in the northern nation — tariff-free access to the US is far from guaranteed.

item.title: Intel Rallies After Saying It’ll Make More Headcount Reductions
item.description: Intel Corp. rallied in early trading Tuesday after confirming it’ll cut more jobs to reduce costs and shake up its key data center unit.

item.title: OpenAI’s Altman to Brief US Officials on Next Wave of AI Models
item.description: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman plans to brief the Trump administration and US lawmakers next week on the upcoming generation of artificial intelligence models as the US works to create a process to review the safety of cutting-edge AI systems, according to a senior company executive.

item.title: Liverpool FC Owners Consider Selling Stake to Bhatia-Led Group
item.description: The owners of Liverpool FC are considering selling a stake in the English Premier League football club to a consortium of investors led by Amit Bhatia.

item.title: Viktor Shvets on Whether Geopolitics Matters for Investors
item.description: Tail risks are growing, but they aren’t everything.

item.title: Apple to Launch ‘Upgrade’ Device Leasing Program With Klarna to Spur Sales
item.description: Apple Inc. is preparing to introduce Apple Upgrade, a leasing program that will mark one of the biggest-ever changes to how the company sells devices.

item.title: Adobe, Salesforce Downgrades Are Latest Show of AI Fears
item.description: Concerns about the impact artificial intelligence will have on software companies have prompted more Wall Street analysts to recommend selling Adobe Inc. and Salesforce Inc. stock than they have in years.

item.title: Nvidia Touts Progress Getting New Rubin Design to Customers
item.description: Nvidia Corp., the semiconductor company at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, said its latest chip designs are making their way to customers and will help solidify the chipmaker’s leadership in the industry.

item.title: SpaceX’s Great Unlocking Begins With $116 Billion Share Release
item.description: SpaceX has set the stage for one of the largest share unlocks in capital markets history, with as much as $116 billion worth of stock becoming eligible for sale for the first time next month.

item.title: Bitcoin Rallies After Bessent Says Clarity Act at ‘1-Yard Line’
item.description: Crypto markets are stirring after months of listless trading on signs that Washington is moving toward a clearer rulebook for digital assets.

item.title: AMC Rolls Out Red Carpet for Debt Investors to Trumpet Rebound
item.description: Dozens of SUVs descended upon AMC’s Lincoln Square theater in New York Monday for an exclusive screening of The Odyssey. But it wasn’t the typical celebrity crowd streaming out of the cars and onto a red carpet.

item.title: India’s Refiners Come to the Rescue of Russia’s Oil Exporters
item.description: Deliveries of Russian crude oil to India so far this month remain near June’s record

item.title: Pakistan Appoints Banks for its Bond and Sukuk Programs
item.description: Pakistan’s finance ministry has appointed banks for its global bond and sukuk programs, according to a statement.

item.title: US Yields Hit Two-Month High as Oil Sparks Inflation Risk
item.description: US Treasuries fell, pushing 10- and 30-year yields to the highest levels in about two months, as a surge in crude oil prices stoked concern that inflationary pressures will prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

item.title: China’s Moonshot in Talks on Pre-IPO Funds at $50 Billion Value
item.description: Moonshot AI is preparing to begin discussions in August on a final round of fundraising before listing in Hong Kong, capitalizing on the excitement around its latest model to raise capital at a valuation of as much as $50 billion.
